material_findings.note: The draft correctly treats V9 as an unexecuted conditional prediction. Sixteen one-card fields challenge only a mandatory separate same-field companion; they do not test or refute compound, implicit, abbreviation, or stencil-supplied quantity models. GDT760/GDT804 are correctly kept out without an explicit VAL-family mapping.

The draft correctly identifies local positional dispatch: preceding chetchy motivates Grade III while Menge III remains live. Accepted forms and historical comparators do not independently identify daiin or numerical value.

The draft correctly keeps the SH+OL instruction shell separate from the optional three-plant composition and from retained ingredient aliases. Atlas insertion counts are implementation coverage, not independent translation.

The draft correctly separates same-carrier/order compatibility from independently established part attachment and temporal operation. The GDT809 tie and repeated okaiin evidence do not select either semantic model.
